newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice futures end quiet session lower.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice futures end quiet session lower.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended a quiet session lower on Friday with weakness tied to indications the hot, dry weather pattern would moderate, traders said.
"This has been one of the lightest (volume) weeks we've had in about two years," one floor trader said.

The market continued to monitor weather patterns in Asia. Traders noted the U.S. agricultural attache in India said some key growing areas had received significantly below normal rains so far and rice transplanting was progressing slowly.
Rice ended six to 1-1/2 cents per bushel lower with September down 1-1/2 at $9.68.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 150 lots, compared with Thursday's actual volume of 211.
